# State Class View (variant): Environmental compliance inspector (local)

> **Not a classification basis / not a job analysis / not for RIF or rating decisions.**
>
> Task importance, time share, critical and needed-at-entry values are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S): assessment pending (job analysis). They are not job-analysis results and no human has reviewed them. Target levels are editorial design drafts. A credential gate is shown only when its issuer is verified with a cited source; the other gates are counted, not shown, until the issuer is verified (CR-CP-001 C7).

- **Role:** Environmental compliance inspector (`seed:R12-environmental-compliance-inspector`, P1); authority position (editorial): regulator
- **Generated:** pipelines/views/state_class_view.py@0.2.0, rule state-class-view@0.1.0 (registered rule, status active), as of 2026-10-23

## Mapped classes

No class is mapped in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)

- Conduct regulatory compliance inspections — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Develop and resolve environmental enforcement cases — journey L2, senior L3
- Target inspections and verify compliance using monitoring data and analytics — journey L2, senior L3
- Manage field sample custody and field quality control — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Build and maintain a defensible administrative record — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Work safely on hazardous, industrial and energized field sites — entry L1, journey L2, senior L2
- Maintain independence and manage conflicts of interest across the regulator-regulated boundary — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Provide compliance and technical assistance to regulated entities and local governments — entry L1, journey L2, senior L2
- Record field observations with protocol fidelity and data integrity — entry L1, journey L2, senior L2
- Assure the quality of environmental data from collection to release — entry L1, journey L2, senior L2
- Maintain the integrity of regulatory and scientific findings under institutional pressure — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — entry L1, journey L2, senior L2
- Evaluate and certify others' task performance against position standards — senior L3
- Measure water quality and survey aquatic communities in the field — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1
- Supervise staff and volunteers in environmental work — senior L3
- Communicate technical environmental information in writing and speech — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
